After a couple of miles things had settled down and one of the pre-race favourites, Peter Riley of Leigh, had grabbed the lead. Phil was in the early 30s, Darren ten places in arrears, and David Anderson keeping an eye on both, just a few seconds behind.
Individual AAA Champion was Chris Davies of Telford (in the red and yellow), second was Peter Riley of Leigh (white vest with green diagonal) and third was our own Mark Miles (177).
In the AAA Championship race Birchfield’s men tore away from the start with only Chris Davies (Telford) and Peter Riley (Leigh) getting anywhere near them.
